id: title:DanielVisca:count metric records capture produces to kafka

observations.behavior: Adds the `metrics` dependency and its `counter` function for recording production counts.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a mechanism to record how many records are produced by this service.

observations.behavior: Increments a Prometheus-compatible counter named "capture_metrics_records_produced" with label "remote_write".
observations.posthog_connection: Records the number of remote-write ingestion events successfully exported to Kafka, potentially used for monitoring or alerting on ingestion throughput.

observations.behavior: Increments the same counter but labeled "otlp" in another export path.
observations.posthog_connection: Records OTLP-based ingestion event counts alongside remote-write, establishing a unified view of total records produced regardless of source protocol.

observations.limitations: The patch does not show configuration changes, dashboard wiring, or tests that demonstrate these counters are actually consumed or acted upon. No tier-3 systemic benefit is demonstrated.

review.limitations: The patch does not show configuration changes, dashboard wiring, or tests that demonstrate these counters are actually consumed or acted upon. No tier-3 systemic benefit is demonstrated.
review.reason: This chunk adds observable instrumentation (Prometheus-compatible counters) across two ingestion paths without changing core behavior or adding new capabilities; it could support reliability/operations visibility if wired into dashboards.
review.posthog_relevance: Adds production-count recording for capture-log exports, which could help PostHog operations and SREs monitor ingestion health and distinguish between remote-write and OTLP sources.
review.uncertainty: Could be narrow maintenance if no downstream consumers exist; otherwise supports Tier 2 observability improvement.
